title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Problem-Solution Essay on Urban Green Space
prompt: In many cities, rapid urbanisation has reduced the amount of green space available to residents. This has led to concerns about the physical and mental well-being of city dwellers. What are the main problems caused by the loss of urban green space, and what solutions can you suggest to address these problems? Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对城市绿地减少带来的问题提出解决方案，写一篇不少于250词的议论文。注意：需明确讨论至少两个问题及对应的解决方案，并保持观点清晰、论证充分。
